full_judgment: 14. Controversy arose as to the method and procedure of applying section 288 Cr. P.C. In the case of Fakira Vs. Emperor, AIR 1937 (PC), 119 Privy Council took the view that once statement of the witnesses is transferred u/s 288 Cr. P.C. it is a statement of evidence for all purposes without limitation.
